  391 #===============================================================================
  392 # Healing move.
  393 #===============================================================================
  394 class Battle::Move::HealingMove < Battle::Move
  395   def healingMove?;       return true; end
  396   def pbHealAmount(user); return 1;    end
  397   def canSnatch?;         return true; end
  398 
  399   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  400     if user.hp == user.totalhp
  401       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP is full!", user.pbThis))
  402       return true
  403     end
  404     return false
  405   end
  406 
  407   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  408     amt = pbHealAmount(user)
  409     user.pbRecoverHP(amt)
  410     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s HP was restored.", user.pbThis))
  411   end
  412 end

  414 #===============================================================================
  415 # Recoil move.
  416 #===============================================================================
  417 class Battle::Move::RecoilMove < Battle::Move
  418   def recoilMove?;                  return true; end
  419   def pbRecoilDamage(user, target); return 1;    end
  420 
  421   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  422     return if target.damageState.unaffected
  423     return if !user.takesIndirectDamage?
  424     return if user.hasActiveAbility?(:ROCKHEAD)
  425     amt = pbRecoilDamage(user, target)
  426     amt = 1 if amt < 1
  427     user.pbReduceHP(amt, false)
  428     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is damaged by recoil!", user.pbThis))
  429     user.pbItemHPHealCheck
  430   end
  431 end

  433 #===============================================================================
  434 # Protect move.
  435 #===============================================================================
  436 class Battle::Move::ProtectMove < Battle::Move
  437   def initialize(battle, move)
  438     super
  439     @sidedEffect = false
  440   end
  441 
  442   def pbChangeUsageCounters(user, specialUsage)
  443     oldVal = user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate]
  444     super
  445     user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] = oldVal
  446   end
  447 
  448   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  449     if @sidedEffect
  450       if user.pbOwnSide.effects[@effect]
  451         user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] = 1
  452         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  453         return true
  454       end
  455     elsif user.effects[@effect]
  456       user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] = 1
  457       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  458       return true
  459     end
  460     if (!@sidedEffect || Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION <= 5) &&
  461        user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] > 1 &&
  462        @battle.pbRandom(user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate]) != 0
  463       user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] = 1
  464       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  465       return true
  466     end
  467     if pbMoveFailedLastInRound?(user)
  468       user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] = 1
  469       return true
  470     end
  471     return false
  472   end
  473 
  474   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  475     if @sidedEffect
  476       user.pbOwnSide.effects[@effect] = true
  477     else
  478       user.effects[@effect] = true
  479     end
  480     user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] *= (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? 3 : 2
  481     pbProtectMessage(user)
  482   end
  483 
  484   def pbProtectMessage(user)
  485     if @sidedEffect
  486       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} protected {2}!", @name, user.pbTeam(true)))
  487     else
  488       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} protected itself!", user.pbThis))
  489     end
  490   end
  491 end

  493 #===============================================================================

  495 #===============================================================================
  496 class Battle::Move::WeatherMove < Battle::Move
  497   attr_reader :weatherType
  498 
  499   def initialize(battle, move)
  500     super
  501     @weatherType = :None
  502   end
  503 
  504   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  505     case @battle.field.weather
  506     when :HarshSun
  507       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The extremely harsh sunlight was not lessened at all!"))
  508       return true
  509     when :HeavyRain
  510       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("There is no relief from this heavy rain!"))
  511       return true
  512     when :StrongWinds
  513       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The mysterious air current blows on regardless!"))
  514       return true
  515     when @weatherType
  516       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  517       return true
  518     end
  519     return false
  520   end
  521 
  522   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  523     @battle.pbStartWeather(user, @weatherType, true, false)
  524   end
  525 end

  527 #===============================================================================
  528 # Pledge move.
  529 #===============================================================================
  530 class Battle::Move::PledgeMove < Battle::Move
  531   def pbOnStartUse(user, targets)
  532     @pledgeSetup = false
  533     @pledgeCombo = false
  534     @pledgeOtherUser = nil
  535     @comboEffect = nil
  536     @overrideAnim = nil
  537     # Check whether this is the use of a combo move
  538     @combos.each do |i|
  539       next if i[0] != user.effects[PBEffects::FirstPledge]
  540       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The two moves have become one! It's a combined move!"))
  541       @pledgeCombo = true
  542       @comboEffect = i[1]
  543       @overrideAnim = i[3]
  544       break
  545     end
  546     return if @pledgeCombo
  547     # Check whether this is the setup of a combo move
  548     user.allAllies.each do |b|
  549       next if @battle.choices[b.index][0] != :UseMove || b.movedThisRound?
  550       move = @battle.choices[b.index][2]
  551       next if !move
  552       @combos.each do |i|
  553         next if i[0] != move.function_code
  554         @pledgeSetup = true
  555         @pledgeOtherUser = b
  556         break
  557       end
  558       break if @pledgeSetup
  559     end
  560   end
  561 
  562   def pbDamagingMove?
  563     return false if @pledgeSetup
  564     return super
  565   end
  566 
  567   def pbBaseType(user)
  568     # This method is called before pbOnStartUse, so it has to calculate the type
  569     # separately
  570     @combos.each do |i|
  571       next if i[0] != user.effects[PBEffects::FirstPledge]
  572       next if !GameData::Type.exists?(i[2])
  573       return i[2]
  574     end
  575     return super
  576   end
  577 
  578   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  579     baseDmg *= 2 if @pledgeCombo
  580     return baseDmg
  581   end
  582 
  583   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  584     user.effects[PBEffects::FirstPledge] = nil
  585     return if !@pledgeSetup
  586     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is waiting for {2}'s move...",
  587                             user.pbThis, @pledgeOtherUser.pbThis(true)))
  588     @pledgeOtherUser.effects[PBEffects::FirstPledge] = @function_code
  589     @pledgeOtherUser.effects[PBEffects::MoveNext]    = true
  590     user.lastMoveFailed = true   # Treated as a failure for Stomping Tantrum
  591   end
  592 
  593   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  594     return if !@pledgeCombo
  595     msg = nil
  596     animName = nil
  597     case @comboEffect
  598     when :SeaOfFire   # Grass + Fire
  599       if user.pbOpposingSide.effects[PBEffects::SeaOfFire] == 0
  600         user.pbOpposingSide.effects[PBEffects::SeaOfFire] = 4
  601         msg = _INTL("A sea of fire enveloped {1}!", user.pbOpposingTeam(true))
  602         animName = (user.opposes?) ? "SeaOfFire" : "SeaOfFireOpp"
  603       end
  604     when :Rainbow   # Fire + Water
  605       if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Rainbow] == 0
  606         user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Rainbow] = 4
  607         msg = _INTL("A rainbow appeared in the sky on {1}'s side!", user.pbTeam(true))
  608         animName = (user.opposes?) ? "RainbowOpp" : "Rainbow"
  609       end
  610     when :Swamp   # Water + Grass
  611       if user.pbOpposingSide.effects[PBEffects::Swamp] == 0
  612         user.pbOpposingSide.effects[PBEffects::Swamp] = 4
  613         msg = _INTL("A swamp enveloped {1}!", user.pbOpposingTeam(true))
  614         animName = (user.opposes?) ? "Swamp" : "SwampOpp"
  615       end
  616     end
  617     @battle.pbDisplay(msg) if msg
  618     @battle.pbCommonAnimation(animName) if animName
  619   end
  620 
  621   def pbShowAnimation(id, user, targets, hitNum = 0, showAnimation = true)
  622     return if @pledgeSetup   # No animation for setting up
  623     id = @overrideAnim if @overrideAnim
  624     return super
  625   end
  626 end
